rows.label: tlk001901_05_msg0001
rows.name: You've been to Acedia, haven't you?

rows.label: tlk001901_05_msg0002
rows.name:
What's it like there? Is
it a place where kids can
be safe on their own?

rows.label: tlk001901_05_msg0003
rows.name:
The kids are excited for seminary,
but so few from this village have
ever gone there that I still worry.

rows.label: tlk001901_05_msg0004
rows.name:
I just hope it's a place where
the kids can fit in easily.
